short: Malaysia has no AI statute. The National Guidelines on AI Governance and Ethics are voluntary, and no AI bill appears on the Dewan Rakyat's 2026 bill list; the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 binds.
title: Malaysia AI Laws
subtitle: No AI act: voluntary national guidelines and the PDPA
body_html:
Status at a glance

No AI act. Malaysia governs AI through the National Guidelines on AI Governance and Ethics (AIGE), published by the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation in 2024, which say of themselves that they are voluntary for stakeholders. No AI bill appears on the Dewan Rakyat's list of bills for 2026, updated 21 October 2026. Parliament did pass two related bills that year: the Cybercrimes Bill 2026 (D.R.8/2026, passed 1 July 2026) and the Communications and Multimedia (Amendment) Bill 2026 (D.R.18/2026, passed 15 July 2026). The binding layer for AI processing personal data is the Personal Data Protection Act 2010, amended by Act A1727 in 2024. Verified on 25 October 2026 against MOSTI and the Parliament of Malaysia.

Key instruments

InstrumentNumberPublishedLegal force
National Guidelines on AI Governance and EthicsMOSTI2024Voluntary
Personal Data Protection Act 2010Act 709, amended by Act A1727Binding

Who regulates and enforces

  • Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MOSTI): issued the AIGE guidelines.
  • Personal Data Protection Commissioner: enforces the PDPA.

Scope and reach

There is no AI-specific scope. The PDPA applies to the processing of personal data in commercial transactions.

Core obligations

  • No binding AI obligations. The AIGE guidelines set principles for developers, deployers and users, voluntarily.
  • The PDPA's data protection principles bind AI that processes personal data.

Penalties

BreachMaximumProvisionEnforcer
Departing from the AIGE guidelinesNone: they are voluntary
PDPA offencesNot stated here: the amended penalties could not be read on an official sourcePDPA 2010, as amended by Act A1727Personal Data Protection Commissioner

What is coming next

No AI bill has been tabled. The Dewan Rakyat's bill list is watched weekly.

Last verified

25 October 2026, against the sources above. Not confirmed on an official source and therefore left out: the PDPA's penalties as amended in 2024, its commencement dates, and reports of an AI governance bill in preparation, because the PDP portal was under maintenance and the Attorney General's Chambers site refused the request.
